senses.zh_definition: 〔英语古语或诗歌用语〕小树林；林木覆盖的山丘。
senses.en_definition: (English, archaic or poetic) A small woodland or a hill covered with trees.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris lama atau puisi, kawasan hutan kecil atau bukit yang diliputi pokok; ini ialah terjemahan penerangan, bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 这是英语义项，不能直接当作马来语普通名词使用。马来语可按语境译为 hutan kecil 或 bukit yang diliputi pokok。下列搭配属于马来语译释搭配，不是 holt 的已核实高频搭配。[Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/holt)

senses.zh_definition: 〔英语〕动物的洞穴式巢穴，尤指水獭的巢穴。
senses.en_definition: (English) An animal's den in a burrow, especially an otter's.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, sarang haiwan berupa lubang, khususnya sarang memerang; ini ialah terjemahan penerangan, bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 在动物观察或保育语境中，应依上下文理解为巢穴。马来语译释可用 sarang memerang。下列为马来语表达示例，未作搭配频率认定。[Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/holt)

etymology.historical_story: English holt has two distinct histories. The woodland word continues Old English holt and is related to German Holz, meaning wood. The animal-den word is recorded from the sixteenth century as a pronunciation variant of hold. Their identical modern spelling therefore conceals different origins. Neither history establishes that holt has become a standard Malay word. [Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/holt)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记英语巢穴义时，把 holt 与 hole（洞）联想：水獭藏进洞穴。只是拼写联想，不是词源关系；马来语表达记 sarang memerang。
